title: Heavyweight champion on CIA operations in Lebanon
place_text: Brotherhood Synagogue, Greenwich Village, New York

tellings.quote: He's talking to us about running operations for the CIA in Lebanon.

plain: An author named Peter Levenda says that in the late 1960s, at the Brotherhood Synagogue in Greenwich Village, New York, a heavyweight boxing champion he names as Andre Pinacio spoke to him and others about running operations in Lebanon for the CIA, America's foreign spy agency. He tells it as an early brush with the world of secret intelligence work.
